_doc: v3 settings for the mobilehq (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from mobilehq_prep.json (work dir mobilehq_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/mobilehq_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: mobilehq

source.title: Praetorian Mobile HQ
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 2, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. WHEELED. The kit's front wheels and module labels were merged into the hull, the front wheel pair and two rear wheels (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r2`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`) on axles fitted to the kit; the front pair is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`. The radar dish and its post (`hq_radar`, on node hq_radar under the stand) is a separate part; it could spin about the vertical axis, but `VehicleRig` has no radar handling yet. Needle triangles dropped; welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse.
